record: Motegi paddock plan and competition operations guide
facts: The dedicated control tower is in the first paddock beside the separate pit garages. The guide identifies an inspection or assembly area at the ground floor, a media center on the second floor and event headquarters upstairs.
Identifies the Control Tower independently from the speedway's Control Room and the Main Straight.
Lists the Motegi venue at 120-1 Hiyama, Haga District.
